title: Physical security perimeter
description: Establish physical security measures and boundaries to prevent unauthorized individuals from gaining physical access to organizational property and assets.

title: Physical entry controls
description: Protect secure areas through defined access points and effective physical entry control mechanisms.

title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
description: Prevent unauthorized physical access, damage, and interference affecting organizational information and associated assets.

title: Physical security monitoring
description: Use physical security measures and monitoring to protect offices and information processing facilities from unauthorized access and security incidents.

title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
description: Identify and implement measures to prevent or reduce the impact of physical and environmental threats affecting information and associated assets.

title: Working in secure areas
description: Protect information within secure areas from damage, unauthorized access, and unauthorized interference by personnel working in those areas.

title: Clear desk and clear screen
description: Reduce the risks of unauthorized access, loss, or damage to information displayed on screens or stored on desks during and outside normal working hours.

title: Equipment siting and protection
description: Reduce risks to equipment and information assets arising from physical and environmental threats, unauthorized access, and damage.

title: Security of assets off-premises
description: Protect organizational equipment and information assets when they are located or used outside the organization's premises.

title: Storage media
description: Protect storage media throughout its lifecycle against unauthorized access, misuse, damage, or compromise.

title: Supporting utilities
description: Protect operations against loss or interruption caused by failures or disruptions to supporting utilities such as power and cooling.

title: Cabling security
description: Protect power and communications cabling against damage, theft, compromise, and disruption to organizational operations.
